a.lede: A joint U.S. government statement says the hacks are affecting the food, transportation, and healthcare industries after reports of global mass hacks.
a.title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers

b.lede: Cybersecurity experts say national impact ‘minimal’ but incidents may represent the ‘foothills’ of a wider threat Food suppliers in the UK have been hit by cyber-attacks after hackers raised the temperatures of supermarket freezers across Europe. The UK’s National Cyber Security Centre (NSCS) said it was working with the affected companies but the national impact was minimal. Continue reading...
b.title: Food suppliers in UK hit by cyber-attacks after freezers targeted in Europe
